chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb, who said:

“Indeed, my father instructed me at the time of death: ‘O Jaʿfar, shroud me in such-and-such a garment and such-and-such a garment, and buy for me one cloak and a turban, and make them good, for indeed the dead take pride in their shrouds.’”

key_terms.أَوْصَانِي: he instructed me as a final testament
key_terms.بُرْدًا: a cloak or outer garment to be used with the burial shroud
key_terms.عِمَامَةً: a turban included among the burial cloths

ai.seo_question: What does Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām say about preparing the shroud for the deceased?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام related his father’s final instruction regarding his burial shroud. It indicates care in preparing the kafan and suggests that the state of the shroud has significance for the deceased in the realm after death.
